title: B002: Zero-DSP FPGA Implementation — Ternary Synthesis v6.3
description: Zero-DSP FPGA implementation achieves 100% DSP elimination through ternary computing. XC7A100T synthesis: 0% DSP, 19.6% LUT (12433/63400), 6.5% FF (8234/126800), 10.4% BRAM (28/270). Power: 1.2W @ 100MHz, 19.2 pJ/OP energy efficiency. v6.3 adds FPGA analysis notebook with resource utilization plots, power analysis, and carbon emissions calculation. 12.5× energy reduction vs FP32 baseline (240 pJ/OP).
